name: Root shells (dev)
purpose: the root shells agents and the Mac's tools open over adb/su (scripts in /data/local/tmp, the rootsh channel): transient, gone with their session - and what they leave in /data/local/tmp, Android's shell scratch directory (agents' ad-hoc scripts, screenshots, logs, staged copies). Nothing is installed there: a real resident file in /data/local/tmp has its own named unit (app-frida's frida-server, idle-sysupdate, phone-dev-tools), which keeps it on this unit's remove; anything running from there is still a process check finds
unbounded: interactive; a background job started from one and left running shows up in check (it leaves the tree)

commands: echo 'removing dev-root-shells deletes the unclaimed scratch in /data/local/tmp (other units files are kept)'
